$comment: T703 — pins for the egress proxy sidecar image (D-28, ADR-0013).
every pin was actually resolved, and each records where its digest came from.
The pin lives beside the Dockerfile it pins, not in the engine's file — the engine
image and this sidecar are bumped by different decisions.

ALPINE_BASE.provenance_note: Docker Official Image. The digest is the multi-arch manifest list; the FROM line in the Dockerfile must carry this exact digest — tests/governance/egress-proxy-image.spec.ts fails on drift.

TINYPROXY_LINE.provenance_note: A minor line, asserted AT BUILD by `tinyproxy -v | grep '^tinyproxy 1.11.'` rather than digest-pinned: apk resolves within the digest-pinned 3.22 branch, and Alpine purges point releases, so an exact -rN pin would rot into an unbuildable image (the DEF-028-006 failure in the other direction). Filter semantics (FilterDefaultDeny whitelist, domain-regex rules, ConnectPort) verified against 1.11 docs via Context7 /tinyproxy/tinyproxy.github.io on 2026-08-19.
